artboards.title: A · The set is the hero (resting)
B · One exercise at a time
A · (same as Main, kept for the record)

annotations.text:
Active workout, second pass. Three structures, same fixture: 12 min in, set 2 of Seated Chest Press is next, a 1:58 rest running, heart rate 128 in zone 3.
A keeps today's structure and fixes the hierarchy: the big elapsed number, the amber Add Exercise and the amber ring all step down; the current set's tick and the rest capsule are the only amber things. The rest is the Start screen's capsule shape, so Skip and +15s cannot wrap.
B shows one exercise at a time with bigger rows and an exercise strip on top.
C collapses done sets to one line and puts the rest right under the set you just finished.
Tab bar, nav bar and icons are stand-ins; the real ones stay.
